posts.text: BREAKING: US interest expense on the national debt hit a record $1.4 trillion over the last 12 months. Since 2020, the cost of servicing US public debt has nearly TRIPLED. If rates remain stable, interest payments are set to rise to $1.7 trillion by November 2028. As a result, interest will surpass Social Security spending as the government's largest outlay for the first time. America's debt bill is spiraling out of control.
